descriptionMarkdown:
Claim-Staker; You gain expertise in Investigation or Survival. You can identify valuable materials, salvage, ore, or structural weaknesses.

Claim-Staker; Your Claim Sight die becomes +1d6 for ability checks.

Claim-Staker; Allies within 30 ft add +1 to checks involving your Claim Sight target.

Claim-Staker; Deep Scan reveals two useful facts instead of one.
